description: This file defines API functions for interacting with a crossword puzzle backend. It provides functions for user authentication, fetching current crosswords, submitting answers, fetching leaderboards, and admin operations such as creating, updating, and activating crosswords. The functions rely on an imported 'client' (likely an axios instance) to perform HTTP requests and return promises.

methods.name: login(username, password)
methods.description: Authenticate the user and retrieve an auth token by sending credentials to the '/auth/login/' endpoint.

methods.name: logout()
methods.description: Logs out the current user by posting to the '/auth/logout/' endpoint.

methods.name: getMe()
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile data from '/auth/me/'.

methods.name: getCurrentCrossword()
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active crossword puzzle with metadata from '/crosswords/current/'.

methods.name: submitAnswer(crosswordId, answers, timeElapsedSec)
methods.description: Submits user's answers for a specific crossword, including time elapsed, to the server at '/crosswords/{crosswordId}/submit/'.

methods.name: getLeaderboard(limit = Number(process.env.REACT_APP_LEADERBOARD_PAGE_SIZE) || 20)
methods.description: Fetches leaderboard entries with an optional limit parameter from '/leaderboard/'.

methods.name: listCrosswords()
methods.description: Admin function to list all crosswords via GET at '/admin/crosswords/'.

methods.name: createCrossword(payload)
methods.description: Admin function to create a new crossword with provided payload at '/admin/crosswords/'.

methods.name: updateCrossword(id, payload)
methods.description: Admin function to update an existing crossword specified by ID with a payload at '/admin/crosswords/{id}/'.

methods.name: setActiveCrossword(id)
methods.description: Admin function to activate a specific crossword by ID at '/admin/crosswords/{id}/activate/'.
